description: Generate test 87: Subject D (English Comprehension), Topic: Active/Passive Voice, 50 questions, difficulty_profile: standard. Save to mock-tests/tests/87_test_D_voice.json. Then run python3 mock-tests/_record_test.py 87.
steps: Read mock-tests/history/D.json to identify all existing Active/Passive Voice questions (from test 54 and any revision tests) to avoid duplicates.

Generate 50 questions on Active/Passive Voice following the steering prompt rules: type distribution for 50Q is Single Correct MCQ: 20, Statement-based: 8, Assertion-Reason: 5, Matching: 5, Multiple Correct Combination: 5, Fill in the Blank: 2, Numerical Value: 2, Data Interpretation: 3. However, for English Comprehension (D), Numerical Value and Data Interpretation are not natural fits -- substitute those with additional Single Correct MCQs. So effectively: Single Correct MCQ: 25, Statement-based: 8, Assertion-Reason: 5, Matching: 5, Multiple Correct Combination: 5, Fill in the Blank: 2. Difficulty distribution for 'standard': Easy 25%, Medium 40%, Hard 25%, Very Hard 10%. Intersperse types randomly.
Ensure all questions follow the exact JSON schema from Section 5. Every explanation must explain why correct AND why each wrong option is wrong.
Ensure no question stem duplicates or near-duplicates any existing entry in history/D.json (especially test 54 which was also Active/Passive Voice).
Save the generated JSON to mock-tests/tests/87_test_D_voice.json.
Run: python3 mock-tests/_record_test.py 87 from the repo root to update history, config, manifest, and STUDY_PLAN.md.
acceptance_criteria: File mock-tests/tests/87_test_D_voice.json exists with valid JSON containing exactly 50 questions
Question types match the adjusted distribution for English Comprehension
No question stem duplicates any entry in history/D.json
findings: Test 87 generated successfully with 50 questions on Active/Passive Voice. Type distribution: Single Correct MCQ=25, Statement-based=8, Assertion-Reason=5, Matching=5, Multiple Correct Combination=5, Fill in the Blank=2. Answer distribution balanced: A=13, B=13, C=12, D=12. No duplicates with existing history (test 54 was also Voice but all stems are unique). Record script confirmed config.json updated to next_test=88.
